editorial:
Imagine waking up one day and realizing nobody can see you. That is exactly what happens to Nick, a wealthy guy who gets caught in a lab accident. Instead of using his new power for good, he spends most of his time panicking while a mean CIA agent tries to hunt him down. It feels like a wild ride that mixes a bit of romance with some silly moments. You get to see the struggle of a man who just wants his old life back but is stuck being a ghost in his own city. It is a lighthearted take on a sci-fi concept that keeps things moving quickly.

What really makes this work is the funny chemistry and the cool special effects for the early nineties. While the plot can feel a bit simple, the tension keeps you interested. If you like movies where a regular person is in over their head, you will love this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can watch it whenever you want.
endingExplained: In the end, Nick uses his invisibility to outsmart the CIA agent and the bad guys. He manages to escape their traps by using the environment to his advantage. After a big showdown, Nick finds a way to live his life despite being invisible. He ends up with the girl he loves, proving that you do not need to be seen to be appreciated. It wraps up on a happy, feel-good note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky 90s movies and lighthearted sci-fi.
